name: AIS vessel traffic
notes: AIS on both channels (161.975 MHz, channel A, and 162.025 MHz, channel B) in one capture of one radio: one `ais_decode` per channel through the `ais_vhf` plan. Start this one to decode AIS or to track ships: vessels land in the Subjects table and on the map, keyed by MMSI. Not a watch: an AIS message is one burst of about 27 ms, too short for a watch's detector to announce, so a watch on these channels starts no decoder.

radio.note: a radio that captures 161.9625-162.0375 MHz at once (75 kHz)
